title: v0.9.5: Qwen3.5/3.6, Gemma 4, Transformers v5
description: Added primary support for Qwen3.5/Qwen3.6/Gemma4 models and compatibility with Transformers v5. title: v0.9.4: Goodbye 2025
description: Farewell to 2025. Thank you to all contributors and supporters. We will continue to deliver an easy and efficient LLM fine-tuning framework to the community in 2026. Stay tuned. Breaking Repository name updated: LLaMA-Factory → LlamaFactory Python 3.9–3.10 have been deprecated; LlamaFactory now requires Python 3.11–3.13 Migrated from pip to uv; use uv pip install llamafactory The official LlamaFactory blog is now live: https://blog.llamafactory.net/en/ New features 🔥 Support Orthogononal Fine-T
author: hiyouga
